plan.notes: Source: official Shiley-Marcos School of Engineering 'B.S. Computer Science Degree Checklist (2020/21 catalog)' PDF (sandiego.edu) — a term-by-term degree plan with printed per-term totals. Transcribed 1:1 from the official checklist; no courses, credits, or prerequisites invented. Course prerequisites (not printed on the term-by-term checklist itself) transcribed from official USD engineering documents on sandiego.edu (DegreePlans21-22 workbook, 2025/26 program checklists); either/or prerequisite alternatives documented in choice_note fields. The 2025/26 sandiego.edu checklists are requirement lists only (not term-by-term), so the 2020/21 term-by-term degree checklist is the newest official term-by-term source per program rules. CREDIT DISCREPANCY (honestly documented): the official PDF's Spring Year 4 rows are COMP 492 (3) + COMP 480 (3) + Core and Electives (12) = 18, but the PDF prints 'Total Hours 15' for that term — a USD typo also present in the 2018/19 checklist. The printed term-total labels sum to 127, but the rows themselves sum to 130; plan.total_credits uses the rows' sum (130) since the individual course rows are the primary transcribed data. USD's university-wide graduation minimum is 124 units; this program's sequence exceeds it under either total. 'Core Curriculum'/'Core and Electives' rows and 'Natural Science' rows have no specific course named on the official plan, so they are choice slots. No 0-credit milestones on the official plan.
